entry.name: jbox
entry.description: Below is a list of attributes shared by all objects. If you want to change one of these attributes for an object based on the object box, you need to place the word sendbox in front of the attribute name, or use the object's Inspector.

attributes.name: annotation
attributes.digest: Sets the text that will be displayed in the Clue window when the user moves the mouse over the object.
attributes.description: Sets the text that will be displayed in the Clue window when the user moves the mouse over the object.

attributes.name: background
attributes.digest: Adds or removes the object from the patcher's background layer.
attributes.description: Adds or removes the object from the patcher's background layer.adds the object to the background layer,removes it. Objects in the background layer are shown behind all objects in the default foreground layer.

attributes.name: color
attributes.digest: Sets the color for the object box outline.
attributes.description: Sets the color for the object box outline.

attributes.name: fontface
attributes.digest: Sets the type style used by the object.
attributes.description: Sets the type style used by the object. The options are:plainbolditalicbold italic

attributes.name: fontname
attributes.digest: Sets the object's font.
attributes.description: Sets the object's font.

attributes.name: fontsize
attributes.digest: Sets the object's font size (in points)
attributes.description: Sets the object's font size (in points).

attributes.name: hidden
attributes.digest: Toggles whether an object is hidden when the patcher is locked.
attributes.description: Toggles whether an object is hidden when the patcher is locked.

attributes.name: hint
attributes.digest: Sets the text that will be displayed as a pop-up hint when the user moves the mouse over the object in a locked patcher.
attributes.description: Sets the text that will be displayed in as a pop-up hint when the user moves the mouse over the object in a locked patcher.

attributes.name: ignoreclick
attributes.digest: Toggles whether an object ignores mouse clicks in a locked patcher.
attributes.description: Toggles whether an object ignores mouse clicks in a locked patcher.

attributes.name: jspainterfile
attributes.digest: Name of a JavaScript file for painting the object.
attributes.description: You can override the default appearance of a user interface object by assigning afile with code for painting the object. The file must be in the search path.

attributes.name: patching_rect
attributes.digest: Sets the position and size of the object in the patcher window.
attributes.description: Sets the position and size of the object in the patcher window.

attributes.name: position
attributes.digest: Sets the object's x and y position in both patching and presentation modes (if the object belongs to its patcher's presentation), leaving its size unchanged.
attributes.description: Sets the object's x and y position in both patching and presentation modes (if the object belongs to its patcher's presentation), leaving its size unchanged.

attributes.name: presentation
attributes.digest: Sets whether an object belongs to the patcher's presentation.
attributes.description: Sets whether an object belongs to the patcher's presentation.

attributes.name: presentation_rect
attributes.digest: Sets the x and y position and width and height of the object in the patcher's presentation, leaving its patching position unchanged.
attributes.description: Sets the x and y position and width and height of the object in the patcher's presentation, leaving its patching position unchanged.

attributes.name: rect
attributes.digest: Sets the x and y position and width and height of the object in both patching and presentation modes (if the object belongs to its patcher's presentation).
attributes.description: Sets the x and y position and width and height of the object in both patching and presentation modes (if the object belongs to its patcher's presentation).

attributes.name: size
attributes.digest: Sets the object's width and height in both patching and presentation modes (if the object belongs to its patcher's presentation), leaving its position unchanged.
attributes.description: Sets the object's width and height in both patching and presentation modes (if the object belongs to its patcher's presentation), leaving its position unchanged.

attributes.name: textcolor
attributes.digest: Sets the color for the object's text in RGBA format.
attributes.description: Sets the color for the object's text in RGBA format.

attributes.name: textjustification
attributes.digest: Text Justification
attributes.description: Sets the justification for the object's text.

attributes.name: valuepopup
attributes.digest: Value Popup
attributes.description: For objects with single values, enablingwill display the object's current value in a popup caption when the mouse is over the object or it is being changed with the mouse.

attributes.name: valuepopuplabel
attributes.digest: Popup Label
attributes.description: Sets the source of a text label shown in a value popup caption.

attributes.name: varname
attributes.digest: Sets the patcher's scripting name, which can be used to address the object by name in, scripting messages to, and theobject.
attributes.description: Sets the patcher's scripting name, which can be used to address the object by name in, scripting messages to, and theobject.
